help.stdout:
usage: gnd doccheck [-h] --artifacts ARTIFACTS model manifest

Discharge the gnd-render-doc skill's obligations by CODE over the document
manifest (skill prose explains, validators discharge). Four obligations: (1)
binding — document_sha256, source_population_sha256 and applicable_sha256
match the actual file bytes; (2) rendering — every role filler of every
APPLICABLE fact type in the source population is mentioned in the document
under lexical normalization, direct fillers as their value and composite
fillers via their identifying component values; inapplicable fact types are
exempt BY the published applicable-set artifact, never by leniency; (3)
distractors — at least one of each kind (out-of-model, near-miss-entity,
absent-fact), every distractor text present in the document, and every absent-
fact distractor genuinely absent from the source population; (4) renderer
identity fields non-empty. Exits 0 when every obligation holds, 3 on any
violation (one line each), 64 on usage errors, 66 when the applicable-set
artifact or any manifest-named file is missing (fail closed — an obligation
that cannot be checked is never skipped).

positional arguments:
  model                 path to the model file
  manifest              path to the document manifest (paths resolve beside
                        it)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --artifacts ARTIFACTS
                        the gnd extract bundle directory holding
                        <stem>.applicable.json

unknown_flag.stderr:
usage: gnd doccheck [-h] --artifacts ARTIFACTS model manifest
gnd doccheck: error: the following arguments are required: model, manifest, --artifacts
